scripts.format: prettier --write src site tests/settings tests/site tests/release/*.mjs index.html package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts src-tauri/tauri.conf.json src-tauri/tauri.windows.conf.json .github/workflows/*.yml README.md CONTEXT.md AGENTS.md CHANGELOG.md docs/*.md docs/adr/*.md && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src site tests/settings tests/site tests/release/*.mjs index.html package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts src-tauri/tauri.conf.json src-tauri/tauri.windows.conf.json .github/workflows/*.yml README.md CONTEXT.md AGENTS.md CHANGELOG.md docs/*.md docs/adr/*.md && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all --check
scripts.test:release: python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests/release -p 'test_*.py' && node --test tests/release/workflow.test.mjs
scripts.test:release:windows: python -B -m unittest discover -s tests/release -p test_release.py && node --test tests/release/workflow.test.mjs
scripts.test:settings: npm run build && cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked --example settings_bridge && playwright test --config tests/settings/playwright.config.mjs
